name: AI Agent Tool
category_description: AI cluster sub-node (model, memory, tool, parser)
description: The AI Agent Tool node allows a root-level agent[^1] in your workflow to call other agents as tools to simplify multi-agent orchestration

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Give a description to the LLM of this agent's purpose and scope of responsibility. A good, specific description tells the parent agent when to delegate tasks to this agent for processing

parameters.name: Prompt (User Message)
parameters.description: The prompt to the LLM explaining what actions to perform and what information to return

parameters.name: Require Specific Output Format
parameters.description: Whether you want the node to require a specific output format. When turned on, n8n prompts you to connect one of the output parsers described on the main agent page

parameters.name: Enable Fallback Model
parameters.description: Whether to enable a fallback model. When enabled, n8n prompts you to connect a backup chat model to use in case the primary model fails or isn't available

parameters.name: System Message
parameters.description: A message to send to the agent before the conversation starts

parameters.name: Max Iterations
parameters.description: The maximum number of times the model should run to generate a response before stopping

parameters.name: Return Intermediate Steps
parameters.description: Whether to include intermediate steps the agent took in the final output

parameters.name: Automatically Passthrough Binary Images
parameters.description: Whether binary images should be automatically passed through to the agent as image type messages

parameters.name: Batch Processing
parameters.description: Whether to enable the following batch processing options for rate limiting:

parameters.name: toolDescription
parameters.default: AI Agent that can call other tools
parameters.description: Explain to the LLM what this tool does, a good, specific description would allow LLMs to produce expected results much more often

parameters.name: notice
parameters.displayName: Connect an output parser on the canvas to specify the output format you require

parameters.name: fallbackNotice
parameters.displayName: Connect an additional language model on the canvas to use it as a fallback if the main model fails

options.name: systemMessage
options.description: The message that will be sent to the agent before the conversation starts

options.name: maxIterations
options.description: The maximum number of iterations the agent will run before stopping

options.name: returnIntermediateSteps
options.description: Whether or not the output should include intermediate steps the agent took

options.name: passthroughBinaryImages
options.description: Whether or not binary images should be automatically passed through to the agent as image type messages

options.name: passthroughBinaryPdfs
options.description: Whether or not binary PDF documents should be automatically passed through to the agent. Useful for models that natively support PDF input (e.g. Google Gemini).

options.name: tracingMetadata
options.description: Custom metadata added to tracing events

options.name: autoSaveHighlightedData
options.description: Whether to automatically save highlighted data.

options.name: enableStreaming
options.description: Whether this agent will stream the response in real-time as it generates text

options.name: batching
options.description: Batch processing options for rate limiting

options.name: maxTokensFromMemory
options.description: The maximum number of tokens to read from the chat memory history. Set to 0 to read all history.

options.name: forceToolCallOnFirstIteration
